name: Candidate
description: Stores candidate and employee profile information including personal details, contact information, employment status, and skills for technical assessments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the candidate

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for communication and login

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Complete name of the candidate or employee

fields.name: employmentStatus
fields.description: Current status: external_candidate, internal_employee, contractor

fields.name: skills
fields.description: List of technical skills and competencies

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the candidate profile was created

name: SkillCategory
description: Defines hierarchical skill categories and competency areas for organizing technical and soft skills into a structured taxonomy

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the skill category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the skill category (e.g., Programming Languages, Cloud Technologies)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the skill category and its scope

fields.name: parentCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to parent category ID for hierarchical taxonomy (null for root categories)

fields.name: level
fields.description: Hierarchy level in the taxonomy tree (0 for root, 1 for first level, etc.)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the category is currently active and available for use

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the skill category was created

relationships.description: Parent-child relationship for hierarchical category structure

check: parentCategoryId IS NULL OR parentCategoryId != id

name: User
description: Stores user accounts for HR team, recruiters, hiring managers, and administrators with authentication and role-based access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name for display purposes

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role (admin, hr_manager, recruiter, hiring_manager)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login for activity tracking

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.email: Must be valid email format and unique
constraints.role: Must be one of: admin, hr_manager, recruiter, hiring_manager

name: Question
description: Store assessment questions with metadata and evaluation criteria

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the question

fields.name: questionText
fields.description: The actual question content or prompt

fields.name: questionType
fields.description: Type of question: multiple_choice, coding_challenge, essay, practical_task

fields.name: skillCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to the skill category this question assesses

fields.name: difficultyLevel
fields.description: Difficulty rating: beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert

fields.name: evaluationCriteria
fields.description: Scoring rubric, correct answers, AI evaluation parameters, and grading guidelines

fields.name: maxScore
fields.description: Maximum points that can be awarded for this question

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: Reference to User who created the question

name: EvaluationCriteria
description: Stores configurable evaluation criteria including scoring algorithms, weighting factors, pass/fail thresholds, and rubric definitions for different question types and assessment categories

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation criteria

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the evaluation criteria (e.g., 'Code Quality Assessment', 'Technical Knowledge Scoring')

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the Question this criteria applies to

fields.name: skillCategoryId
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the SkillCategory this criteria applies to

fields.name: scoringAlgorithm
fields.description: Type of scoring algorithm (e.g., 'weighted', 'binary', 'rubric-based', 'ai-evaluated')

fields.name: weightingFactor
fields.description: Weight multiplier for this criteria in overall scoring (0.0 to 1.0)

fields.name: passThreshold
fields.description: Minimum score required to pass this criteria (percentage or points)

fields.name: rubricDefinition
fields.description: JSON object containing rubric details, scoring levels, AI prompts, and evaluation parameters

relationships.description: Links criteria to a specific question
Links criteria to a skill category

constraints.questionOrCategory: Either questionId or skillCategoryId must be provided

name: AuditLog
description: Comprehensive audit trail capturing all user actions, data modifications, and system activities for compliance and security monitoring

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who performed the action

fields.name: action
fields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, VIEW, LOGIN, LOGOUT)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., Candidate, Question, Assessment, User)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the affected entity

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of modified data

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

relationships.description: Links audit log entry to the user who performed the action

indexes.name: idx_user_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimize queries filtering by user and time range

indexes.name: idx_entity_action
indexes.description: Optimize queries tracking specific entity changes

indexes.name: idx_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimize time-based queries and log retention policies

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain for minimum 7 years for compliance requirements

name: Assessment
description: Stores assessment templates and configurations for candidate evaluations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assessment template

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the assessment template

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of assessment purpose and content

fields.name: assessmentType
fields.description: Type of assessment (technical, ai_ml, behavioral)

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: Time limit for completing the assessment in minutes

fields.name: passingScore
fields.description: Minimum score percentage required to pass (0-100)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this assessment template is currently available for use

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: Reference to User who created this assessment template

relationships.description: Skill categories covered by this assessment

constraints.assessmentType: Must be one of: technical, ai_ml, behavioral

name: AssessmentAssignment
description: Links candidates to specific assessments with scheduling, access control, and completion tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assessment assignment

fields.name: candidateId
fields.description: Reference to the candidate taking the assessment

fields.name: assessmentId
fields.description: Reference to the assessment being assigned

fields.name: accessToken
fields.description: Unique token for secure assessment access

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: Due date and time for assessment completion

fields.name: attemptsRemaining
fields.description: Number of attempts left for the candidate

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status: pending, in_progress, completed, expired

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the assessment was completed

relationships.description: Each assignment belongs to one candidate
Each assignment is for one assessment

constraints.uniqueAssignment: Unique constraint on (candidateId, assessmentId) to prevent duplicate assignments
constraints.statusValues: Status must be one of: pending, in_progress, completed, expired

name: AssessmentResponse
description: Stores candidate answers and submission data for assessment questions including timestamps, responses, and versioning for multiple attempts

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assessment response

fields.name: assessmentAssignmentId
fields.description: Reference to the assessment assignment this response belongs to

fields.name: questionId
fields.description: Reference to the question being answered

fields.name: responseData
fields.description: Candidate's answer data including text, code, multiple choice selections, and any attachments

fields.name: timeSpentSeconds
fields.description: Total time spent on this question in seconds

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version number for tracking multiple attempts or auto-saves of the same question

fields.name: submittedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the response was submitted or last saved

fields.name: isSubmitted
fields.description: Indicates whether this is a final submission or a partial save

relationships.description: Each response belongs to one assessment assignment
Each response is for one specific question

name: AssessmentResult
description: Store scored results and evaluation outcomes for completed assessments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assessment result

fields.name: assessmentAssignmentId
fields.description: Reference to the assessment assignment that was completed

fields.name: overallScore
fields.description: Final calculated score (0-100)

fields.name: skillBreakdown
fields.description: Skill-level scores mapped by skill category ID with individual scores

fields.name: aiInsights
fields.description: AI-generated analysis including strengths, weaknesses, and recommendations

fields.name: evaluationStatus
fields.description: Status of evaluation: pending, completed, reviewed

fields.name: evaluatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the assessment was evaluated

fields.name: evaluatedBy
fields.description: User ID of evaluator or 'system' for automated evaluation

relationships.description: Links to the specific assessment assignment
Access to detailed response data through assignment
Links to the user who performed evaluation (if manual)

constraints.evaluationStatus: Must be one of: pending, completed, reviewed
constraints.skillBreakdown: JSON object with skill category IDs as keys and score objects as values

name: Report
description: Store generated reports and analytics snapshots with metadata, configurations, and export formats

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the report

fields.name: reportType
fields.description: Type of report (individual_assessment, comparative_analysis, team_performance, trend_analytics)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Report title or name

fields.name: generatedBy
fields.description: Reference to User who generated the report

fields.name: configuration
fields.description: Report parameters and filters (date ranges, candidates, assessments, metrics)

fields.name: content
fields.description: Generated report data including charts, statistics, and analysis results

fields.name: exportFormat
fields.description: Available export formats (pdf, excel, csv, json)

fields.name: generatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the report was generated

name: NotificationLog
description: Records all system notifications and communications sent to candidates and users, including delivery status and retry tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: ID of the recipient (Candidate or User)

fields.name: recipientType
fields.description: Type of recipient (Candidate, User)

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (assessment_invitation, reminder, result_ready, deadline_warning, etc.)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Communication channel used (email, sms, in-app)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

relationships.description: Links to Candidate when recipientType is Candidate
Links to User when recipientType is User

name: SkillGapAnalysis
description: Stores AI-generated skill gap analysis comparing candidate performance against benchmarks with improvement recommendations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the skill gap analysis

fields.name: assessmentResultId
fields.description: Reference to the assessment result being analyzed

fields.name: skillCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to the skill category with identified gap

fields.name: gapSeverity
fields.description: Severity level of the skill gap (critical, high, medium, low)

fields.name: currentScore
fields.description: Candidate's current performance score in this skill area

fields.name: targetScore
fields.description: Expected or benchmark score for this skill area

fields.name: recommendations
fields.description: AI-generated improvement recommendations and learning path suggestions

fields.name: analyzedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the gap analysis was performed

relationships.description: Links to the assessment result being analyzed
Links to the skill category with identified gap
